content: Infinite recursion RLS error on profiles happens when a policy on profiles runs a query that itself selects from profiles under RLS (e.g. a policy subquery like 'exists (select 1 from profiles where id = auth.uid() and role = ...)' evaluated as SECURITY INVOKER). Fix: wrap the same-table lookup in a SECURITY DEFINER function, which runs with elevated privilege and bypasses RLS on that internal lookup, breaking the recursive policy-evaluates-policy cycle.
